description: Current drug shortages in Saudi Arabia, sourced from the SFDA shortage list (www.sfda.gov.sa/en/currentlyInShortageList): generic name, availability status, and how many trade-name products are affected. Filters are applied by the SFDA server. Arabic status values are translated to English (original kept in status_ar).

page.description: Page number, zero-indexed (each page has 10-20 rows). Default 0.

scientific_name.description: Filter by generic/scientific name substring, e.g. "AMOXICILLIN".

name: sfda_drug_shortages
title: Sfda Drug Shortages
